item.title: Indianapolis Motor Speedway partners with Big Brothers Big Sisters for mentor drive
item.description: Big Brothers Big Sisters of Central Indiana and the Indianapolis Motor Speedway have partnered to recruit 500 volunteer mentors by the Indianapolis 500, in an effort to help the more than 1,000 children on the organization's waiting list.

item.title: Find your furry friend at Lucky Tails Adoption Event in Indianapolis, all fees waived
item.description: Indianapolis Animal Care Services is hosting the Lucky Tails Adoption Event on March 14, offering waived fees, microchipped, spayed/neutered, and vaccinated pets, as well as goody bags and adoption counselors to help find the perfect match.

item.title: Pop duo The Driver Era set to rock University of Southern Indiana’s SpringFest
item.description: The University of Southern Indiana will host alternative pop duo The Driver Era for a public concert at Liberty Arena on April 11, 2026, with tickets available for the general public and free for USI students.

item.title: IU dominates Minnesota on Senior Night
item.description: IU cruised to a 77-47 win over Minnesota on Senior Night, ending a four-game losing streak, with Sam Alexis leading the charge with 23 points and Lamar Wilkerson making his 100th three-pointer of the season.

item.title: Purdue takes down Northwestern behind career day from C.J. Cox
item.description: Purdue beat Northwestern on the road, 70-66, with C.J. Cox leading the Boilermakers with 27 points, snapping a two-game losing streak.

item.title: Iran fires more missiles at Israel, US military bases in 6th day of fighting
item.description: Early on March 5, 2026, Iran launched missiles at Israel and the U.S. military bases in the Middle East, a day after the U.S. and Israel intensified their bombardment of Iran.

item.title: Target’s Baby Boutique coming to 3 central Indiana stores
item.description: Target is expanding its baby category with the introduction of Baby Boutique spaces in nearly 200 stores, including three in central Indiana, and online. The goal is to offer a specialized shopping experience, with nearly 2,000 new items, to help parents make informed decisions.

item.title: Attorney charged with stealing items from car in former HSE football player’s fatal crash
item.description: Indianapolis attorney James "JD" Masur faces criminal charges for allegedly stealing items from the car involved in the crash that killed former Hamilton Southeastern student Mason Alexander without permission from law enforcement or the vehicle's owners.

item.title: Former Indiana funeral home owner arrested, accused of stealing from clients
item.description: Zalo Wilson, a former funeral home owner from northeastern Indiana, was arrested in Maine on 64 theft charges for stealing over $500,000 from people who prepaid for funeral arrangements at Wilson-Shook Funeral Homes.
